final_message:
I searched the BA job board for "Softwareentwickler" in München and assessed six suitable listings. Note: your stored profile location is Hamburg (25 km radius). You specifically asked for München, so I searched München as requested — below are the results and fit summaries. Tell me which listings you want to save, apply to, or reject, or if you want me to re-run the search for Hamburg (your profile area) instead.

Shortlist (reference — title — employer — fit category)
1. 12117-YF-48852-YF-S — Softwareentwickler — bayoonet AG (München) — poor
   - Matches: hybrid model (3 days on-site / 2 remote), backend/cloud topics listed (Docker, Kubernetes, REST, IaC), full-time.
   - Gaps: ad asks for very good German & English; generalist with varied possible focuses (not specifically Python/FastAPI/Postgres); degree/embedded or regulated-domain experience noted. Seniority not stated.

2. 14225-d10be3b2dd249dcf-S — Softwareentwickler - IT — PartSpace GmbH (München / by arrangement remote) — poor
   - Matches: CI/CD, Azure DevOps, automated tests, agile processes.
   - Gaps: strong .NET/C# backend focus (not Python/FastAPI); domain-specific skills (CAD/PLM) and other responsibilities that don't match your Python/Postgres stack.

3. 10001-1003863378-S — Softwareentwickler (Landesvermessung) — Landesamt für Digitalisierung, Breitband und Vermessung (München) — partial
   - Matches: full-time, unbefristet, up to 80% home office, Java and DB work.
   - Gaps: Java-focused (not Python); requires very good German; domain (surveying/geodata) and security/IT-hardening experience expected.

4. 10001-1003935843-S — Softwareentwickler C#/.NET — Baader Bank AG (Unterschleißheim ~15 km) — poor
   - Matches: REST APIs, microservices, DB work (mentions Postgress), CI/CD, agile.
   - Gaps: primarily C#/.NET role (not Python/FastAPI); German language expected (very good) though English is used.

5. 19121-44499216-1011-S — Systemnaher Softwareentwickler — genua GmbH (Kirchheim bei München ~14 km) — poor
   - Matches: system-level development, C and shell, security-focused company, flexible/mobile work.
   - Gaps: low overlap with your Python/FastAPI/Postgres stack; requires very good German (B2+) and Unix/C expertise.

6. 12336-a26f1128j0452080-S — Senior Softwareentwickler - .NET MAUI, Blazor & Cloud — TÜV SÜD AG (München) — partial (low-evidence)
   - Matches: senior title, CI/CD, cloud, Azure DevOps, agile practices.
   - Gaps: .NET MAUI/Blazor/C# focus (not Python); few explicit Python/Postgres/FastAPI signals.

Summary observations
- Many Munich-area roles are C#/.NET, Java, or system/C-focused rather than matching your Python / FastAPI / PostgreSQL stack.
- Several roles require very good German; your profile lists basic German and native English — this reduces fit for those ads.
- Remote/hybrid options appear in several ads but vary; one state role explicitly allows up to 80% home office.
- I limited results to 6 assessed listings to keep a focused shortlist. I used up to three search refinements while staying within the BA search rules.

Suggested next steps (choose one)
- I can save any of these listings to your application tracker (tell me which reference number(s) and status: saved / applied / rejected, optional follow-up date and note). I will call the tracker directly.
- I can re-run the search centered on Hamburg (your profile location) to find roles closer to you.
- I can broaden the Munich search to include keywords like "Python" + "Backend" and increase publication age or radius (if you want more matches), though earlier attempts returned few Python-specific Munich listings.
- I can filter these six by language requirement or remote percentage and re-assess.

Which action do you want next? (If you want any listing saved/applied/rejected, give reference numbers and status.)
